title: KEX30 or NEWKEYS as the very first message answered with UNIMPLEMENTED
quote: Key exchange begins by each side sending SSH_MSG_KEXINIT
rationale: First input KEX30 or NEWKEYS (no client KEXINIT yet) answered with UNIMPLEMENTED and the connection kept (v1 D8: OpenSSH, Dropbear). CAVEAT: our mapper then sends its own KEXINIT automatically, the teammate's never does, so the two harnesses test different message sequences here. Written by proto-sm stream A (v2) from v1 class D8 (report.md); vocabulary: teammate mapper (UNIMPLEMENTED, SERVICE_ACCEPT, CLOSED/NO_CONN, UA_PW_OK). An accepting word is a behaviour witness, not necessarily a bug.
